question: How many customers are from France?
generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'France';

question: List the names of all products in the Electronics category.
generated_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics';

question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2025%';

question: What is the total quantity sold for each product?
generated_sql:
SELECT products.id, products.name, SUM(orders.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM products
JOIN orders ON products.id = orders.product_id
GROUP BY products.id;

question: Which customer placed the most orders?
generated_sql:
SELECT customers.name
FROM customers
JOIN orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id
GROUP BY customers.id
ORDER BY COUNT(orders.id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: What is the total revenue generated by each product?
generated_sql:
SELECT products.id, products.name, SUM(products.price * orders.quantity) AS total_revenue
FROM products
JOIN orders ON products.id = orders.product_id
GROUP BY products.id;

question: Which customer spent the most money?
generated_sql:
SELECT customers.name, SUM(products.price * orders.quantity) AS total_spent
FROM customers
JOIN orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id
JOIN products ON orders.product_id = products.id
GROUP BY customers.id
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which product category generated the most revenue?
generated_sql:
SELECT p.category, SUM(p.price * o.quantity) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which customers spent more than the average amount spent by all customers who placed at least one order?
generated_sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.id
HAVING SUM(o.quantity * (SELECT price FROM products WHERE products.id = o.product_id)) > (
    SELECT AVG(total_spent)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(o.quantity * (SELECT price FROM products WHERE products.id = o.product_id)) AS total_spent
        FROM orders o
        GROUP BY o.customer_id
    ) AS customer_spending
);

question: Which product was ordered by the largest number of different customers?
generated_sql:
SELECT p.name
FROM products p
JOIN orders o ON p.id = o.product_id
GROUP BY p.id
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
